meta.paths: survey_ride: straight along the wind for 10 s, one level turn at 10 deg/s, then a crest ride (the swell's phase speed, 7 m/s along the crest, phase 0.9 rad, 10 m above the local surface); oracle: the oracle closed loop's own path (no survey)
meta.errors: phase: estimated minus true linear phase of the dominant swell (the components within [0.75, 1.33] of its peak frequency) at the aircraft; height: |estimated amplitude minus the local amplitude| over the swell's Hs / 2; p90 and median pooled over the seeds and the 10 s before each check

meta.how: as the oracle wave loop (sim.wavelib.run_wave_job) with fly_mpc's world model 'estimated': the rig's sensors every step, SwellEKF at every plan, the planner and the wave pilot in the estimated sea moved into the true frame by the navigation error; the pilot flies the start's steady leg for 10 s, then the survey circle (a level turn of 36 s at the leg's airspeed), until the estimate is ready (at most 240 s)
